provenance: Transcribed aggregate values from the submitted Stage 3 report. Original YOLO11s checkpoints and per-seed logs were not retained. These numbers are historical reported results, not measurements of the new checkpoints.
f1_note: YOLO11n's reported F1 can be reproduced by taking the harmonic mean of aggregate P/R within each seed, then averaging seeds. It is not the mean of class F1 values. YOLO11s F1 cannot be independently verified without original per-class outputs. Stage 4 computes explicit macro-F1 from detections.
